editor.name: Workflow name
editor.name_required: Give the workflow a name before saving.
editor.check_failed: The drawing could not be checked: {message}
editor.rerun_hint: A new run starts here, reusing what the earlier steps said in this run.

form.title: Title
form.id_hint: Later steps read this step's output as {path}.
form.attachments_note: Workflow steps cannot carry attachments yet.
form.condition_path_hint: A value the run can read: input, steps.<id>.output or trigger.<field>.
form.condition_raw_hint: The form cannot split this condition into parts; edit it as text.
form.condition_routes_hint: Yes follows the success connections; no follows the failure ones.
form.delay_hint: Up to an hour. A longer wait belongs in a schedule.
form.delay_template: The wait is read from {value} when the step runs.
form.notify_to: Goes to the inbox of whoever runs the workflow.
form.approval_who: Anyone who can answer approvals in this profile approves or denies it — here, in the inbox, or from the pending bar.
form.approval_required: Ask for approval before this step runs
form.rules_hint: Each rule compares a path — trigger.event, trigger.task_id, trigger.body.…, steps.<id>.output — with a value. Yes follows the green connections, no the red ones; a no with nothing after it ends the run as “filtered”.

issues.edge_from_unknown: This connection starts at a step that does not exist.
issues.edge_to_unknown: This connection ends at a step that does not exist.
issues.delay_out_of_range: The wait must be 0 to {detail} seconds.
issues.template_root_unknown: It reads {detail}, but a step can only read input, trigger or steps.
issues.template_step_unknown: It reads {detail}, but there is no such step.
issues.workflow_empty: The workflow has no steps yet.
issues.no_start: Every step has a step before it, so the workflow has no starting point.
issues.many_starts: {detail} steps have nothing before them; they all start together.

workflow_editor.no_steps: No steps yet. Add the first one below.
workflow_editor.steps_hint: A new step follows the last one on success; open a step to change what follows it. Long-press a step to move it up or down.
workflow_editor.remove_step_title: Delete this step and its connections?

limits.title: Limits
limits.hint: What every run of this workflow may use. An empty field has no limit; a run may still set its own.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.hint: An address on this hub that another service (ClickUp, GitHub…) sends events to. Each event that passes the signature check and the event filter starts a run with the event as {{trigger.…}}. The hub must be reachable from the internet.
triggers.save_first: Save the workflow first, then add a trigger.
triggers.url_hint: Give this address to the sender. It stays the same.

secret_hint.clickup: Register the webhook in ClickUp with the address above; paste the “secret” from ClickUp’s answer here.
secret_hint.github: The secret you typed in the GitHub webhook’s settings.
secret_hint.generic_hmac: The secret the sender signs the body with (HMAC-SHA256).
secret_hint.token: The token the sender puts in the header.

triggers.secret_stored: A secret is stored. It is never shown; typing a new one replaces it.
triggers.secret_missing: No secret yet: every delivery is refused until one is stored.
triggers.delete_body: Its address stops answering and its delivery log is deleted. The sender keeps sending until you remove the webhook there too.

send.title: Send message
send.hint: Sends the step’s words to Telegram and/or a Core Hub conversation.
send.telegram_hint: A chat, user or group id (a group is like -1001234567890). Sent by this profile’s own Telegram bot; long text is split into several messages.
send.conversation_hint: Posted in the conversation, so it shows in every app. If the conversation is deleted, a new one with the same title is made and the step points to it.
send.sample_hint: The message uses variables. Type a value for each before a test is sent; the web page of this workflow can also take them from its last run.
send.preview: Preview of what will be sent

alert.title: When a run fails
alert.hint: The workflow’s name and the run’s error. Telegram and a conversation work as in a Send message step.

test.title: Test this step
test.bad_json: The sample event is not valid JSON.
test.yes: Yes — the green connections would follow
test.no: No — the red connections would follow

workflow_editor.run_filtered: Filtered: not one to act on
